name: Neuron Graph Compiler (neuronx-cc)
notes: neuronx-cc (XLA-based, NeuronCores v2) and neuron-cc (TVM-based, v1). Auto-casts FP32 to BF16. Optimization levels 1-3. NEFF output. Mixed precision: FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8. Model-specific optimizations (Transformer, U-Net). Logical NeuronCore sharding.
